visual_review: The foreground soldier is prone and appears defeated. The crosshair stays over its torso. This is a human visual label; the policy has no entity-life flag.
regression_criterion: Replay the fallen-soldier frames and measure attack-button ticks after the death animation settles, ammunition spent, and time to resume navigation. Check a live soldier in a similar view for prompt acquisition and shots. Preserve close moving targets and partially occluded enemies.
planner_handoff: Keep standing, fallen and uncertain as separate camera observations. The local player should release an unconfirmed lock promptly. A planner may request disengagement or a fresh look; advice expires when the player leaves or reloads the scene. An unchanged total kill count alone cannot establish a particular target is dead.

isolated_planner_check.method: Both archived RGB inputs were passed independently to the background planner. The reported case included recent game actions and the visible HP value. The control contained a standing enemy. Labels were inspected before the requests.

plan.objective: Find ammunition and health before continuing.
plan.evidence: The HUD shows 16 health and the ammunition counter appears empty.
plan.success: The ammunition or health display increases after collecting a pickup.

plan.objective: Advance down the corridor past the armed enemy.
plan.evidence: An armed enemy stands on the left beside the corridor.
plan.success: You reach the far end of the visible corridor.

isolated_planner_check.scope: Two image classifications. This does not demonstrate that the live local detector releases a fallen target.
isolated_planner_check.interpretation: MiniMax labeled the prone figure fallen and the standing control active. It also described the ammunition display as apparently empty on the prone frame. The visible HUD read 14. A correct character label does not validate the rest of the advice or establish that the live player released the lock.

posture_and_motion_check.method: Replay each recorded input and own save/load operation. Check saved observation hashes. Feed actual RGB images, camera inputs, attack-button state and HUD ammunition to the tracker. A completely visible broad silhouette must match its earlier texture through repeated shots before the lock is retired. A changed appearance can be reacquired.

native_branch.interpretation: The changed live branch moved away from the body. No retained-pose release was logged in that branch, so attribution to the rejection rule comes from the identical-frame comparison.
